assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / identity-preserving cover redesign.
Create ONE professionally art-directed illustrated GAME PROMOTIONAL KEY VISUAL that can also serve as a title-screen layout preview. User authorizes redesign of IMAGE 1 to give it strong game-marketing appeal. 16:9 landscape, target 1920x1080, opaque, no crop needed. All required character bodies, sword, cloak tips, hands, boots and words remain inside 4% safe margins.

INPUT ROLES:
Image 1: existing composite, DESIGN TO REWORK. Its broad twilight palette and paired ancient stone gates/steps are approved. The current passive character catalog arrangement, overly chunky central button and detailed paving need improvement.
Images 2 and 3: approved ORIGINAL CHARACTER IDENTITY MASTERS. Preserve identities strictly, use these faces and costumes rather than reinterpretations from Image 1. Hand-painted 2D fantasy animation illustration, rounded yet confident shape design, softly faceted paint and restrained texture; not 3D, realistic concept art, vector clipart or pixel gameplay.

MAIN ART DIRECTION: an ancient decisive confrontation. Tell the viewer immediately WHO is confronting WHOM, and WHAT makes this game distinctive. Create a cohesive key-art composition with hierarchy: expressive faces and inward gestures -> memorable readable title -> concise mathematics/legend promise -> modest start affordance. Pose and gaze can be adjusted slightly for stronger visual storytelling, while preserving identity, proportions, costume, and one complete believable sword.

CHARACTERS:
Hero Liwei on LEFT, three-quarter body turned RIGHT, composed brave face looking toward the king, not smiling at camera. Warm brown skin, shoulder-length brown braided curly hair, single approved golden hair ornament, navy/ivory costume, waist-length teal cloak, compass, brown tall boots. Sword's exact original blue-lit blade and gold hilt. One hand securely on one sword hilt, the other hand naturally free; do NOT invent another sword or extra hands. Angle the one sword in a strong inward diagonal toward the upper-center-left, fully in frame and clear of title and faces. Grounded balanced stance. No anatomy or costume redesign.
Ancient king Heen on RIGHT, three-quarter body turned LEFT, calm persuasive but menacing expression, eyes toward the hero, one deliberate open hand extending inward to imply confrontation. Approved wavy dark hair with white streak, goatee, tall purple collar, charcoal/navy robes with violet lining, single gold clasp, brown boots. Retain only the tiny magic detail that already exists in the original, reduced in attention, no invented powers. No sword, plants, horn crown or new jewelry. His cloak is imposing but must not swallow the heroine's visual importance.
Both full-body figures have coherent scale and share a grounded baseline around y87-89%. Faces at comparable visual emphasis; hero around x24%, king around x76%. Keep the central region clear; face and hand silhouettes have breathing room. Give their cloth only a restrained directional movement, not a hurricane.
Unify scene lighting: a broad natural warm twilight light from left grazes both characters, with subdued violet reflected shadow. Actual contact shadows under boots. No bright uniform neon cutout outlines. Do not paste them as unrelated sticker standees.

SCENE:
A single ancient stone duel court. LEFT gateway/steps remain broad, gently curved, teal-accented and warmer; RIGHT same categories remain taller, sharper, violet-accented and heavier. Same ancient construction family with different shape language echoing the two costumes. Massive plain stones with just a few softened age-worn edges convey antiquity. Gateways sit behind the figures and are darker and simpler than them. Foreground paving now consists of a handful of large quiet painted planes, with very few joints; remove mottled scratches, intricate cracks and repetitive flecks. Distant forest/hills read as two soft silhouette groups. Reduce sky to two broad dusk/cloud masses and a restrained amber opening; it supports faces and title, not a spectacular weather subject. Architecture subtly frames the impending confrontation. No destruction, seal failure or new world lore.

PROMOTIONAL TYPOGRAPHY / INTERFACE:
Top center in the space BETWEEN heads, around y16-29%, prominent exact Traditional Chinese title "數學勇者". Strong custom illustrated display lettering with simple warm ivory/amber face, a thin dark navy outline/shadow; coherent restrained hand-crafted shape, not generic heavy gold extruded type or huge metallic bevel. Do not cross heads, sword or fingertips. Allow clean negative space around the title.
Below, around y33-39%, exact concise promotional line "算出答案，迎戰傳說", readable but clearly subordinate.
A SINGLE smaller start plaque at lower-center, around y75-82%, exact text "開始冒險". Simple flatter matte navy stone face with restrained warm edge, minimal texture, no massive thick 3D gold frame. It belongs visually to the stone scene and does not compete with faces/title.
Replace the bulky three-line tutorial block with ONE discreet but legible line along lower-center around y92%, exact wording:
"限時解題｜答對出劍｜答錯或敵人蓄力滿時受擊"
Render all specified Traditional Chinese accurately, once each. No other slogans, character names, logos, English, UI icons, status bars, cards, navigation, decorative separators or extra buttons.

The result must stay clear at thumbnail scale: opposing recognizable heroes, distinct ancient architectures, central brand, one small action. Use stronger selective dark-light grouping and silhouette overlap for drama, not increased object count. No swirls, energy collision, lightning, particle confetti, gratuitous glow or cinematic lens effects. Complete figures and clean glyphs; no extra fingers, merged hands, doubled weapons or overly symmetric ornamental filler.

cover_concept.prompt:
Use case: compositing, identity-preserve. Create ONE review-only game title-screen cover concept for the Traditional Chinese math adventure game 數學勇者. This is an art approval mockup, not production sprites or an implemented screen. Landscape 16:9 canvas, target 1920 x 1080, fully opaque painted background. Single image, one frame, no atlas or grid. Keep every required character, entire sword, hands, boots, cape, shadows, and existing effects fully inside the canvas with at least 64 pixels padding at the target size. Do not crop or distort the figures.

Input image 1 is the locked original full-body illustration of the heroine 黎薇 (Livy), a warm-brown-skinned young female hero with shoulder-length braided brown hair, one gold hair ornament, navy clothing, teal-blue waist-length cape, compass, brown long boots, and exactly ONE blue glowing sword. Input image 2 is the locked original full-body illustration of the ancient demon king 赫恩 (Hearn), the 奪輝王, with dark wavy hair, distinctive white hair streak, goatee, dark charcoal clothes, purple-lined sweeping cloak, gold clasp and brown boots. Preserve both original characters' identity, face, costume, accessories, proportions, and painted rendering extremely closely. Compose the supplied figures into the scene; do not redesign them, do not make them photorealistic or pixel art, and do not mirror costume asymmetries. Livy appears on the left third, Hearn on the right third. Her stance is courageous and composed, his expression intelligent and threatening. Use their supplied full-body poses and silhouettes. Hearn never has a sword or plant decoration. Preserve only the small existing magic effect from his reference; it is an illustration motif and not a new defined power. Do not change Livy's cover pose into the later pixel-art stance.

Background: a modestly detailed ancient stone courtyard under a dramatic dusk sky, with irregular weathered stone texture, a few large offset architectural silhouettes and hazy distant hills, foreground and background separation, grounded contact shadows. This is a proposed ancient cover location, not a canon claim about current world geography. No destroyed or breaking seals, no portals, no plot about a returned demon king, no other characters. The current Twilight Forest is peaceful because Livy defeated and sealed Hearn long ago; this title screen presents that past legend. Use subdued indigo and muted plum atmosphere on Hearn's side, restrained blue-teal accent near Livy's actual sword, and warm natural grazing light on stone. Atmospheric drama comes from scale, value contrast and depth, not dense glitter or arbitrary luminous rings. Visually asymmetric composition and believable cloth, worn leather and brush texture. Avoid sterile gloss, mirror symmetry, repetitive meaningless gold ornament, excessive particles and overly smooth surfaces.

Composition: put the two entire characters on a shared ground plane near the left and right edges, leaving a generous open central third for game typography. Keep sky and scenery behind the central text low contrast and quiet. A visual hierarchy of large title in the upper center, one integrated game-like start control beneath it, and three short legible instruction lines lower in the central space. These are elements within a full-screen game scene, not a website. No webpage header, navigation, cards, sidebar, dashboard, boxed tutorial panels, or browser chrome. Do not show HUD, health bars, answer choices, world lore sections, rewards or pixel sprites in this concept. Scene extends edge to edge. The start control can look like a simple worn stone inset with a restrained blue rim, no ornate gold frame. Keep all wording clear and readable, do not shrink to cram.

Render only the following exact Traditional Chinese text:
Large main title: 「數學勇者」
One start control: 「開始冒險」
Below the control, three concise instruction lines:
「答對：出劍，壓回敵人蓄力」
「答錯：敵人反擊」
「敵人蓄力滿：受到攻擊」
Do not render quotation marks, character labels, extra text, decorative unreadable script, subtitles, artist signature, watermark or English. Typography should suit a painted fantasy game, with solid legibility and minimal ornament. This is a cover mockup only; actual gameplay remains pixel art and will be designed later.
